context:
Goal: the tracking-stamp merge fix and the check-in time fix reach the live Worker, so the phone gets them.
Problem (risk): deploying main b3ccea4e would also take live everything built since the live Worker version 320c719d (2026-10-28), including POST /orders and GET /orders/status, the Recent-log merge and the CSV re-import refresh, while your deploy ruling ("Deploy both together after PR 390 merges", item 124 b) names only the two fixes; a live Worker change touches real check-in data, so only you say how far it reaches.
Based on (read): `wrangler deployments list` shows the live code from 2026-10-28, and `git log` on worker/ and src/ lists the other changes (read by the coordinator).
Based on (ruling): item 124 b; PR 390 merged 2026-11-22 23:42 CST, PR 408 (check-in time) merged 2026-11-23 03:14 CST.
Departs from: live Worker 320c719d — runs main b3ccea4e.
Waiting on: your answer; the coordinator then deploys, and the other lanes run meanwhile.
holds: The live Worker deploy waits for your answer.

lastAnswer.note: a: deploy main as is (saved on the page).

options.gain: Tracking updates, check-in times and the other merge fixes reach the phone now, and a rollback to 320c719d is one command.
options.how: The coordinator deploys main b3ccea4e to the live Worker as it is.
options.label: Deploy main as is
options.lose: The orders endpoints go live before your first run of them; they sit idle until the extension calls them.

options.gain: The live change stays inside your ruling.
options.how: A stripped build carries only the tracking-stamp merge and the check-in time fix, and goes live after its own review.
options.label: Deploy only the two fixes
options.lose: A separate stripped build with its own review, and the web and Worker merge rules differ until the rest ships.

options.gain: You review each undeployed change first.
options.how: Nothing goes live until you say.
options.label: Hold the deploy
options.lose: The phone keeps the old merge.

short: Worker deploy: main as is, two fixes, or hold
